Name: George

SpeechStyle: Gruff, short, and blunt. Complains frequently. Initial responses are dismissive or grumpy. Occasionally shows a softer side. Uses 'bah' and 'hmph' type exclamations.

Relationships.Evelyn: wife (appreciates her more than he shows)
Relationships.Alex: grandson (proud of him but struggles to express it)

Backstory: George has lived in Pelican Town for decades. An accident left him in a wheelchair, which made him bitter about the things he can no longer do. Despite his grumpy exterior, he genuinely loves Evelyn and Alex, and can develop a warm friendship if someone takes the time to get past his rough shell.
